d:
Thermal cameras locking onto unexplained heat signatures, sudden equipment failures in cursed ruins, and cryptid hotspots tested in real time. Dive into the all-time best moments of Expedition X as the team confronts the world's strangest paranormal mysteries head-on. Relive the most iconic investigations, shocking discoveries, and unforgettable encounters from the unknown.
Watch Expedition X Season 1 Episodes 1, 2 & 5, Season 2 Episodes 2, 7 & 10, Season 3 Episodes 1, 4 & 5, and Season 4 Episodes 10 & 13 on Discovery Channel India.
